items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (30-60 Day Post-Install)
items.preview:
**Audience:** Referral push candidates, 30 recipients (satisfied, recently installed, honeymoon-window trust is highest here)
### Subject Lines (curiosity / pain / authority / specific)
- **Primary (specific):** `Your water is dialed in. Now the fun part.`
- Alt 1 (curiosity): `The thing our best clients do at 60 days`
- Alt 2 (specific/$): `$500 for the neighbor with the rusty water`
- Alt 3 (authority): `Who do you know drinking bad water?`
- Alt 4 (pain): `Still hear neighbors complain about their water?`
### Preview Text
`A quick thank you, and a way to put real cash in your pocket for it.`
### Body
Hi [First Name],
It has been about six weeks since we installed your ClearWave system in [City], and I hope the water has been exactly what you hoped for.
Quick note from me directly. Most of our new clients came from someone just like you telling a friend. So we make it worth your while.
Here is how it works:
If you refer someone and they become a client, you get **$500 cash**. Refer more and it climbs: **$750** for referrals 6 through 9 in a year, and **$1,000** each once you hit 10.
If someone you send us books a consult but does not move forward, we still send you a **$50 gift card** for the introduction.
All they need is a **free water assessment**. We handle the rest.
Just reply with a name and the best way to reach them, or send them straight to us. That is it.
Thank you for trusting us with your home.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
### Send Timing
**Tuesday, 10:00 AM ET** (mid-morning weekday peak for high-trust personal notes)
### Expected Performance
- **Open: 55-65%.** This is a warm, recently-serviced micro-segment (30 people) with a personal-tone subject, well above your 42.3% baseline and dramatically above the fatigued broadcast sends.
- **Click/reply: 8-12%.** Referral is a reply-based CTA, not a link click, so track replies. Concrete dollar figures drive action.
- **Conversion: 2-4 booked consults, 1-2 likely closes.** Even one close at these ticket sizes ($8,980 systems in this list) dwarfs the $500 payout.
### Source Justification
Draws from **Jobber Lifecycle Triggers → Referral push candidates (30-60 days post-install, satisfied)** and the **Referral Bonus Structure** exact numbers. Honors Rule 3 (referrals, not reviews) and Rule 3a (exact phrase "free water assessment"). No legacy names printed; uses tenure line per Rule 2.
---

items.title: Email Campaign · : Concierge "Year 1.5" Math (13-24 Month Segment)
items.preview:
**Audience:** Concierge upsell candidates, 100 recipients (already past year-1 service, off Concierge). Recurring revenue is the highest-leverage play in the pipeline.
### Subject Lines
- **Primary (curiosity):** `The question we get at month 18`
- Alt 1 (specific): `Is the $99 Concierge worth it for you? The math`
- Alt 2 (pain): `Who is remembering your filter swaps?`
- Alt 3 (authority): `What year-2 clients ask us most`
- Alt 4 (specific): `$99/mo, and here is exactly what it covers`
### Preview Text
`No pressure. Just the honest breakdown so you can decide for yourself.`
### Body
Hi [First Name],
It has been well over a year since we installed your ClearWave system in [City], and by now you have had your first annual service done. So you know how we work.
Here is the question we get most around this point: "Is the Concierge plan actually worth it for me?"
Fair question. Here is the honest math.
Concierge is **$99/mo** and covers:
- Your annual service, done automatically
- Filter swaps on schedule (no remembering, no guessing)
- Priority phone support when you need us
- Parts coverage on the standard install components
If you would rather stay pay-as-you-go, that is completely fine. This is not for everyone. But if you like the idea of never thinking about maintenance again and having your parts covered, the plan usually pays for the peace of mind on its own.
Want the breakdown for your specific setup? Reply and I will have someone run your numbers.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
### Send Timing
**Thursday, 11:00 AM ET** (later-week, considered-decision content performs better than Monday/Friday)
### Expected Performance
- **Open: 45-52%.** Larger segment (100) than Proposal 1, but still trust-warm and past year-1 service. Curiosity subject beats your discount-style losers by a wide margin.
- **Click/reply: 3-5%.** Soft, reply-based CTA with a genuine "not for everyone" frame reduces resistance.
- **Conversion: 3-6 Concierge signups.** At $99/mo, 4 signups = ~$4,750/yr recurring, compounding across future sends.
### Source Justification
Draws from **Jobber Triggers → Concierge upsell candidates (13-24 months, not on Concierge)** and the **Concierge Upsell Context** block ($99/mo, coverage details, "the question we get asked at year 1.5" framing, non-pushy voice). Respects Rule 1 hard floor (list is pre-filtered to 13-24 months, all past year-1 service). Uses tenure line per Rule 2 (no legacy names like "Re-Ionator Pro" printed).
---
### Why these two, and what I skipped
- **Cold re-engagement (1,000):** high volume but your deliverability is already wounded. Blasting 1,000 unengaged contacts now risks further spam-folder damage. Better to rebuild sender reputation with the two small high-intent sends above first, then run cold re-engagement next week from a warmer standing.
- **1-year annual service (15) & RO replacement (27):** solid operational sends, but lower revenue-per-send than referral cash and recurring Concierge. Queue these for next week.
**One data caveat:** a 42.3% "average open" alongside five recent sub-0.5% campaigns suggests either a tracking/reporting break or that the average predates a deliverability collapse. Worth confirming your Mailchimp authentication (DKIM/DMARC) before the next broadcast-sized send.

---

*Generated by the Email Sub-Agent · idea sourcing per IDEA_SOURCING.md · sign-off rule: "Justin / CEO / ClearWave" two-line, no em dash prefix.*
